CustomField.inlineHelpText: If a resolution was declined, did the CM explain next steps to the customer? If the proposed resolution was declined, did the CM ask why this was not appropriate and look for another option? If no other options, did the CM: · Explain why their proposed resolution was declined · Provide factual information regarding our position · Acknowledge how the customer is feeling · Outline next steps? E.g. "You have the right to pursue your complaint with AFCA, I can provide you with their contact details”
CustomField.label: Resolution declined- next steps advised
